about_the_game:
Reborn as Defense Tower

ProtoBlue Tower is a mix of tower defense and survivors games. You have been reborn as a defense tower with the power of the mystical ProtoBlue. Wave after wave of enemies must be repelled as you protect a small village that is unfamiliar to you. As the village continues to grow, so too will your responsibilities. Become the most powerful defense tower this village has ever seen. Use the energy of ProtoBlue that flows through this land to improve yourself with powerful spells and upgrades.

Experience the power of ProtoBlue

  • 10+ towers - Towers come with different specializations that bring out the best in you.

  • 30+ abilities, many combinations - Optimize your tower with active and passive abilities.

  • Diverse progression system - Roguelite mechanics give you random selections of abilities and upgrades between attack waves.

  • Ongoing challenges - Defending larger villages and cities, more enemies, and larger enemy types continuously increase the difficulty level.

  • Meta progression - Successful battles and missions unlock new towers and abilities.

ProtoBlue Tower is not your typical tower defense game, not your standard tower - YOU are the tower.
